test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

All the __kith and kin__ of my deceased landlady were present to attend her funeral.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term** "kith and kin"** refers to one's friends and relatives, but in the context of a funeral, the term "blood relatives" is more appropriate.
 
• The phrase** "blood relatives" **specifically refers to family members by birth, which is more fitting for a funeral setting.
 
• The other options such as **"office colleagues," "secret enemies," and "special students"** do not fit the context of a funeral for a landlady.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"All the **blood relatives **of my deceased landlady were present to attend her funeral."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "office colleagues"** – This option is inappropriate because it does not relate to family connections, which are typically expected at a funeral.
 
• **Option 2: "secret enemies"** – This option is not relevant in the context of a funeral.
 
• **Option 3: "special students"** – This option does not fit the context of a funeral for a landlady.
 
• **Option 4: "blood relatives"** – This is the most appropriate option as it directly refers to family members by birth.
